policy.members: All Hunt/Reffert members of non-rejected o/m/g/d groups; Vasiliev/Baumgardt memberprob>=0.5.
policy.regions: Hunt/Reffert Type o/g: max(rt,rJ) degrees among finite positive published King/Jacobi radii. Vasiliev/Baumgardt published query rmax arcmin /60. No arbitrary radius cap. Region flag is background quarantine, not membership.
policy.region_limitations: Full rtot encloses sparse tails in enormous discs (Hyades49deg, Coma36deg); it is not used as background guard. All catalogued members including tails remain reserved by ID. Uncatalogued tail members and missing clusters are not guaranteed excluded.
policy.binary: El-Badry2021 endpoints and R reproduced in Hwang2022 full 1817594-row table; reserve both endpoints for finite R<0.1; components share minimum endpoint source_id.
policy.distances: No reference distances used. Gaia-selected membership/near-equal binary distances do not give an independent Gaia absolute calibration.
policy.split: Every reference match is external, taking precedence over any spatial or random split.
policy.epoch: Gaia membership IDs are EDR3/DR3; centers are published coordinates. Region radii are broad group radii, not arcsecond crossmatch gates.
